newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Fudosan higher on hopes for land policies.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Fudosan higher on hopes for land policies.

text.p: Shares of Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd climbed on Friday, supported by hopes that new policies to activate land transactions will emerge after a new government is formed after Sunday's elections, traders said.
The listing of shares in Oriental Land, which is expected to take place later this year, also inspired buying because Mitsui Fudosan is a big shareholder of Oriental, they said.
Mitsui Fudosan's share price was up 20 yen at 1,510 yen at 0055 GMT, on volume of 2.569 million shares.
